responsibility: Declares the Go frontend’s type hierarchy and supporting classes for methods, named and forward-declared types, type contexts, and runtime type-kind constants. This header is the central definition point for representing Go types, method sets, type descriptors, comparability/hash behavior, backend conversion interfaces, and the type metadata that other frontend subsystems consume.
same_name_distinction: Declares the type hierarchy, method-related support classes, runtime type-kind constants, and type-context structures shared across the frontend. Unlike `types.cc`, it is the structural definition and interface layer for type objects, not the code that resolves, verifies, exports, or lowers them.
